reference.title: Configuring Wi-Fi
reference.shortdesc: The following procedures describe how to enable and configure the JACE-8000 Wi-Fi adapter to operate in Access Point mode, Access Point Controlled mode, and Client mode. Also covered are instructions on how to discover, add, and connect to available access point networks.

section.p: You can configure WLAN communications using the platform Wi-Fi Configuration view in . Connect to (login) your desired target platform, right-click on the platform icon and choose ViewsWi-Fi Configuration from the popup menu. The Wi-Fi Configuration view displays.
